title: Pendulum, small and large swing
objective: Measure the pendulum period for small and large swings

primary_metric.name: period relative error
primary_metric.definition: |T_measured - T_reference| / T_reference; reference 2 pi sqrt(L/g) (small) or 4 sqrt(L/g) K(sin(theta0/2)) (large)

references: arXiv 2603.14634, analytic pendulum test (the seven analytic tests)
Elliptic integral K by the arithmetic-geometric mean (Abramowitz and Stegun 17.6)
model_assumptions: point mass (inertia 1e-9) on a massless rigid rod, no damping, no contact, g = 9.81 m/s^2, RK4 with 0.2 ms steps, period = mean interval between upward zero crossings over 13 s.

variants.task: Point-mass pendulum, length 1.0 m, released from 0.05 rad.

grading: referee/criteria.json via oracle.py (stdlib only, run in a separate isolated interpreter)
